attempts.rationale: test a weighted combination using inverse_error to exploit the strong trend dominance and moderate ranking stability.

The series shows a strong trend and moderate ranking stability, but the weighted inverse_error already uses all models. Testing a simple mean may reveal if averaging without weighting improves robustness.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4064. Series context: trend strength 0.9911 and seasonal strength 0.3059; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.431); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 59.376.
